# Key Decisions

### 2026-08-17 (breakroom review-drain session) — Prefer rejecting bad state over silently correcting it, and hold a correct change that claims a reserved namespace

**Decided:** Three of the 24 PRs were held rather than merged, on three different grounds. **#142** was held despite its rule being correct and well-evidenced, because it creates the root CLAUDE.md that open issue #64 (requires:human) reserves verbatim in its Non-scope. **#112** was held on a reproduced regression.
